title: Pele – Mermaid diagrams as themeable SVG
summary: Pele is a tool that converts Mermaid diagram syntax into beautifully themed SVG outputs, allowing developers and designers to customize the visual appearance of their diagrams beyond Mermaid's default styling.
problem_solved: Solves the limitation of Mermaid diagrams having limited theming options by providing a way to export fully themeable SVG graphics.
why_valuable: Enables consistent, branded diagram styling across documentation and presentations without manual SVG editing.
